verdict_text:
YES

The renumbering map (`kept = [0,1,3,4,6,7,9,10,11]` → `0..8`) matches clause 2 exactly, the rewrite goes into a fresh dict so no surviving block can be overwritten, non-block names pass through untouched (clause 3), and both asserts run before `mkdir`/`save_file`, so a failure exits non-zero with nothing written. The index-set assert (`== set(range(9))`) covers both "no blocks 9–11 remain" and "exactly 9 blocks", and `len(out) == 121` covers clause 4.

Two caveats that don't change the verdict: the checks are bare `assert`s, so they'd be stripped under `python -O`; and correctness of dtype/value preservation rests on `_ckpt.load_checkpoint`, which isn't part of the artifact shown.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
